name: Sorrowmurk
summary: Green dragonkin guard the way to the Sunken Temple in Sorrowmurk. East of the Pool of Tears, this wetland remains one of the most perilous reaches of the eastern marshes.

sections.title: A Perilous Border
sections.body: Along the eastern edge of the Pool of Tears, you reach Sorrowmurk where the mire meets the Forbidding Sea. Green dragonspawn and towering drakes patrol its waters and tangled boughs. They are remnants of the brood sent to watch over the submerged Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Their presence makes these sodden reaches perilous for any traveler.

faq.answer: Sorrowmurk lies along the coast in the easternmost Swamp of Sorrows, beyond the Pool of Tears and the sunken ruins of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Green dragonkin inhabit Sorrowmurk. Aggressive dragonspawn and large drakes patrol the marsh around the temple waters.

faq.q: Why are there green dragons in the Sorrowmurk?
faq.answer: Ysera tasked the Green Dragonflight with watching over the Pool of Tears and keeping the evil sunken within the Temple of Atal'Hakkar contained.

angles.text: As a druid, you may find the green dragonkin here a tragic sight. Corruption touches the Emerald Dream's guardians in these wetlands.
